# GTA VI Companion — Catalog maintenance and reconciliation

This document records internal source comparisons, unresolved identity matches, progress-ID decisions and historical research notes. These are not verified gameplay claims.

## Standout performance and card reconciliation — November 27, 2026

Sources: [GTA Town road comparison](https://gtatown.com/garage/best-cars/standout-car), [GTA Town off-road comparison](https://gtatown.com/garage/best-off-road-standout-vehicles), [FindLeonida card directory](https://findleonida.com/en/collectibles/trading-cards/).

- 525 distinct field-level additions across 237 existing records: 236 vehicle road composites, 225 off-road menu ratings, 63 other menu ratings (12 speed, 16 acceleration, 15 asphalt handling, 20 strength), and one card pickup landmark. A record can have more than one added field. No new checklist slots or GPS links were created.
- GTA Town road composites are site-defined comparison values, not an in-game rating. Menu ratings use a 0–10 scale; GTA Scoop scores use a distinct 0–1000 scale. Existing values and tiers were preserved, and existing numeric off-road ratings were not repeated.
- The four unmatched labels Flipside Enduro, Bret's Rebel, Dubsta (custom), and Elegy (custom) were not forced into other slots. Vanessa's Growler was matched to the existing pink-bow reward (ID 233). Unlisted vehicles, aircraft and watercraft were not assigned inferred ratings.
- FindLeonida's 480-card directory was reviewed as a search aid, not a definitive game checklist. Existing landmark descriptions already covered several candidates. Only the additional Flamingo Parkway shelf-corner clue for Maximus Goldbart (Yellow), ID 873, was added; the conflicting Beverly/Dominant identity remains unresolved.
- Remaining research: exact pickup points for roster-only vehicles, source conflicts on collectible identities and map totals, and individual wildlife encounter locations. No claim of in-game confirmation or hardware testing is made.

**Questline trophy audit (2.0.1):** The eight qualifying strands are Merle, Freddie, Kirk, Kyle, Alvan, Yago, Papa Audacity and Pilot Pete; credit is awarded at the finale. The [PowerPyx index](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-strangers-freaks-side-missions/) and [GTABase roster](https://www.gtabase.com/gta-6/strangers-missions/) agree on this list. Timed errands are distinct from trophy requirements. New November 27 walkthroughs identify [three ATM targets](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-yasmanis-atm-jobs-walkthrough/), the optional [Gold Blammer](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-yasmani-steal-the-gold-blammer-walkthrough/) and [small-bank tips](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-yasmanis-bank-jobs-walkthrough/). The latter two may be skipped by progressing to the Chapter 4 vault tutorial; the ATM tip expires after one in-game day. These are documented under existing mission entries, not assigned new progress IDs. The complete game mission roster is broader than the 43-entry checklist.

**Special Weapons reconciliation (2.0.1):** All 94 named entries in the [PowerPyx 130-slot roster](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-weapons/) already map to existing IDs; its remaining 36 entries are unnamed, not 36 proven missing variants. All 24 entries in the [GTA Top free-find and mission guide](https://gta-top.com/en/gta-6/unique-weapons) and all 24 items in the [Palm Underworld retailer table](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-unique-weapons/) match existing catalog records. These bounded roster checks are complete. Targeted guide references are not new GPS pins. The [November 27 GTA6GPS directory](https://gta6gps.com/map/game/weapon-variants) supplies 25 additional named marker URLs after collision checks. The 137 entries include ordinary weapon pickups: PowerPyx lists the H-AT, GLR40 and Hawk & Little Morgan as standard weapons. Unnamed markers, disputed variant spellings, and store restrictions remain provisional. GTABase's JavaScript-rendered 115-marker list is not individually accessible, so that directory is not declared complete. No new IDs were assigned.

## November 26 research follow-up (2.0.1)

- [Delivery Day](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-delivery-day-meet-randy-walkthrough/) and [Collect the Tempesta](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-collect-the-tempesta-walkthrough/): final wishlist sequence, trophy, follow-up garage, registration and resale terms. Domestic Timbers is a reference-only garage lead, not a new checklist identity.
- [Kenton sets](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-kenton-sets-locations-search-the-dive-sites/) and [Maritime Dispute](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-maritime-dispute-stop-by-kentons-shop-walkthrough/): batch progression, contact tracker, late dive unlocks and unresolved discovery overlap for Belpoint/Bobcat. [Fish roster](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-fish-fishing/): study versus catch credit.
- [Frampton bunker](https://lootradar.net/secrets/frampton-island-bunker-code-3612), [alternate report](https://gta6.house/guides/gta-6-frampton-island-bunker-code), [robot warehouse](https://lootradar.net/easter-eggs/decor-district-robot-doll-warehouse), [Chase rescue](https://lootradar.net/easter-eggs/furry-rescue-chase-fox-furry-dw-9), [alternate Chase cash report](https://gta6.house/library/characters/chase), [Casanova watch](https://lootradar.net/loot/crowex-octane-kaleidoscope-rainbow-watch-casanova-island), [Freddie retest](https://lootradar.net/secrets/unlock-hurricanes-freddie-bunker-north-leonard-county) and [relationship tip](https://lootradar.net/tips/open-car-door-for-lucia-relationship): reported routes and conditions; no independent game verification.
- Nine individual [GTA6GPS Standout maps](https://gta6gps.com/map/game/standout-vehicles) were matched to existing records. Three candidate pins (918847, 918200, 918701) were withheld because the existing catalog already associates them with other identities or locations; no remapping without reconciliation. All progress IDs and ranges retained.

### Additional vehicle and watch reconciliation

- [GTA6GPS unique vehicle directory](https://gta6gps.com/map/game/unique-vehicles): 8 newly matched individual NFC pins, revised acquisition clues and map coordinates. Existing conflicting location leads retained without reassignment.
- [Vice City Hustle watches](https://www.vicecityhustle.com/guides/gta-6-luxury-watches) and [GTA6 Maps watches](https://gta6-maps.net/categories/luxury-watches): alternate pickup reports, wardrobe credit and minimum watch requirement. Named markers are not necessarily distinct collection slots.

### Card identification and pet menu reconciliation

- [AllThingsHow card table](https://allthings.how/gta-6-collectible-cards-list/) (Nov 26): reported printed player positions, baseball AVG, family categories, artwork subjects and contestant years. Player-level metadata applies to existing color variants; no extra card identities or locations implied. Junior/Tusi Taufua and other differing names remain unresolved; no automatic rename.
- [Nexzy Flamingos](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/vice-city-flamingos-cards), [Penetrators](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/liberty-city-penetrators-cards), [Wrath](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/liberty-city-wrath-cards), [Backyard Wrestling](https://www.nexzyapp.com/games/grand-theft-auto-vi/guide/bam-backyard-wrestling-cards): selected photo-based access clues and alternate reports. No new progress IDs.
- [PowerPyx Cats & Dogs](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-cats-dogs/) (Nov 26): 34 menu positions. Random residential spawns do not resolve the remaining three cat-specific encounter gaps; unusual-animal locations still need independent confirmation.
- Additional PowerPyx menu-order references: [Hunting](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-hunting-animals/), [Fishing](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-fish-fishing/), [Birds](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-birds/), [Mammals](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-mammals/), [Aquatic](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-aquatic-animals/), [Reptiles and amphibians](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-reptiles-amphibians/). Exact name matches only; differences in the roster do not create extra animals. Menu slots locate a missing entry in the game, not its world spawn.

- [FindLeonida card directory](https://findleonida.com/en/collectibles/trading-cards/) (Nov 26): 79 additional item-specific alternate map references, matched by name, variant and pickup clue. The directory marks 391 of its 480 locations as not checked in-game; these are labeled separately. Existing locations and checkmarks are retained.
- [PC Gamer Missing Persons walkthrough](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-missing-persons-locations/) and [GTA6Maps.wiki](https://gta6maps.wiki/gta-6-missing-tourists-locations/): Chapter 1 warehouse lead, victim landmarks, Chapter 2 completion and paired-branch glasses reward. **Standout vehicle directory reconciliation (2.0.1):** All 86 entries in the [GTA Best map directory](https://gtabest.com/gta-6/map/standout-vehicles) match 85 existing records; Third Eye Youga is listed twice. **Named roster leads:** The [GamesDB 25-set roster](https://gamesdb.gg/gta-6/vehicles/standout) reports 271 named variants. All 17 names also appear in the [Alcast named roster](https://alcasthq.com/gta-6-standout-vehicles/). These are separately named variants now allocated as IDs 5222–5238 after enumerating every progress-bearing record in the complete supplied archive and comparing both progress-range indexes. Targeted variant and mission guides distinguish several previously ambiguous aliases. These leads also appear in Stunts & collections.

- **Lagoon Schafter:** Ocean Beach container; Street Racer; speed 7.6, acceleration 7.5, handling 4.5. Separate from Nightlight.
- **Burning Cypher:** Port Gellhorn container; Stock Car; speed 8, acceleration 8.3, handling 5.2. Separate from Bareback and Pop Art.
- **Status RSX:** Gellhorn Raceway recovery truck; Stock Car; speed 8.7, acceleration 8.7, handling 7; reported registration $40,650, sale $10,655.
- **Highwayman Sanchez:** Billy robbery story bike; Race Bikes; retention not verified.
- **Smokescreen Carbon RS:** Port Gellhorn building-site container; Race Bikes; speed 7, acceleration 8, handling 7.6. Not Hung Carbon RS.
- **Bullion Gauntlet:** Millport cargo container; Ripped & Shredded.
- **Beast Chino:** Lake Tallaloko luxury resort; Retro; exact parking spot not verified.
- **Dogfight FCR:** VCIA flight school; Retro; aviation styling, not Booty FCR 1000.
- **Obsidian Sovereign:** Draper Island shipping container; Retro; not Peacock or Blood Fever.
- **Raul's Coquette Classic:** Ocean Beach marina; Retro; distinct from ordinary 1964 Coquette in variant lists.
- **AudaCity Sanchez:** Chapter 3 Trial by Tire, La Perle parking garage; use during mission, retention not verified.
- **AudaCity Sandking:** Chapter 3 Quit Your Job, Sell Your House; after hospital drop-off keep or sell. Alternate Vice City Sign stunt: Key Cloner, alarm, no tracker. Reported registration $4,400.
- **Interdimensional Youga:** Abandoned in Mount Kalaga National Park; Fine Art; separate from Third Eye at Grayson.
- **Lacewing Maverick:** Crosstown rooftop; Law & Order; exact roof access not verified.
- **Independence Boomazoom:** Bar by Lake Leonida; Americana-style livery; exact bar unverified.
- **Sandblasted Cliffhanger:** Breakwater Quarry container corroborated by GTABase and GTA Town; All-Terrain; distinct from Magma.
- **Chrome Street Blazer:** Roadside cargo crate, Port Gellhorn; All-Terrain; distinct from Azalea and Tormentor.

**Variant source cross-checks:** [Lagoon Schafter](https://gtatown.com/garage/vehicles/lagoon-schafter), [Burning Cypher](https://gtatown.com/garage/vehicles/burning-cypher), [Status RSX](https://gtatown.com/garage/vehicles/status-rsx), [Smokescreen Carbon RS](https://gtatown.com/garage/vehicles/smokescreen-carbon-rs), [Coquette variant comparison](https://gameta.gg/gta6/vehicles/64-invetero-coquette/), [Interdimensional Youga](https://gtatown.com/garage/vehicles/interdimensional-youga), [Sandblasted Cliffhanger](https://www.gtabase.com/gta-6/vehicles/sandblasted-cliffhanger), [AudaCity Sanchez](https://www.gtabase.com/gta-6/vehicles/audacity-sanchez), [Sandking acquisition](https://howtovideogame.com/gta-6-sandking-location/), [Papa mission walkthrough](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-quit-your-job-sell-your-house-help-papa-audacity-walkthrough/). [Leonida Players](https://leonidaplayers.com/guides/gta-6-hunting-guide-bret-target-decks-best-rifles-all-61-animals) and [ViceBoard](https://viceboard.com/guides/gta-6-target-deck-locations/) cover early decks only. Expanded meteorite and flamingo directories contain existing landmarks, aliases and unnamed markers; withheld ambiguous matches rather than assign new IDs or append maps to already linked entries. No live gameplay or firmware compilation performed.

## Documentation consolidation — November 27, 2026

The following previous README material is retained for catalog maintenance and historical traceability. Counts and source claims are snapshots; the user-facing README and actual TSV catalogs take precedence.

### Memory usage and installation

Quick Guide topics are loaded from `assets/catalogs/guide_sections.tsv` (title, mode, body, zero-based first wildlife row, count). Glitches are loaded from `guide_glitches.tsv` using the same five-field structure; `money_map` mode uses field four for the NFC map label and field five is reserved (0). The selected row index is passed to the specialized money guide renderer, which reads the body from the same catalog. Randomized safe-code tips are a standard `text` topic in `guide_sections.tsv`. The legacy `wildlife.tsv` asset (page title, animal name, encounter/equipment/identification notes) is retained for the optional wildlife mode, but no current Quick Guide row uses that mode. The current 18-topic Quick Guide and 15-entry Glitches menu read titles from storage, load only the selected topic (and at most 16 wildlife rows when applicable), and release temporary records/indexes. The collection progress page calculates live saved progress from `progress_ranges.tsv` (inclusive sorted first/last ID ranges, regenerate when catalog IDs change); the money guide uses the existing warehouse URL in `links_00.tsv`. Escapes `\\`, `\n`, `\t` and `\r` are decoded by the shared TSV loader. Collection and vehicle detail rows use the same escape decoding; escaped paragraph breaks display as actual line breaks. Preserve row order or update guide ranges when adding/reordering wildlife entries. Secret mission navigation links are in `secret_map_targets.tsv` (secret ID, collection asset, collection ID). The optional eighth field in `cheats.tsv` holds single-source inputs such as Pinhole separately from platform input fields. Menu routing, controller behavior, save layout, collection group synchronization and structural catalog descriptors remain code. Missing or malformed guide assets report unavailable rather than requiring a compiled-in copy.

### Memory usage and installation

Catalogs use UTF-8 TSV files without headers or a byte-order mark. Preserve progress IDs and unique keys in the NFC link catalogs. Item links are partitioned into `assets/catalogs/links_NN.tsv`, where `NN` is the zero-padded decimal result of dividing the item ID by 256 (integer division). Only nonempty partitions need to exist. Each lookup scans the item’s partition; category fallback remains in `link_categories.tsv`. Optional `links_extra_NN.tsv` partitions add up to eight labeled URLs per item without changing the six-column legacy format. Each extra row contains nine tab-separated fields: `id`, then four `label` / `url` pairs. Pad unused pairs with empty fields. If the first row contains four URLs, a second row keyed `id:2` may supply four more. Labels describe the location or purpose; the app adds the provider name. Exact duplicate URLs are merged, retaining a supplied location label. A shared GTA6GPS category map is offered first when no item-specific GTA6GPS reference exists. Remove the obsolete monolithic `assets/catalogs/links.tsv` when upgrading the source tree. Enable `GTA_RAM_DIAGNOSTICS` to log free heap, minimum free heap, the largest free heap block, and the app task's unused stack watermark.

### Catalog reference coverage

The [WikiGTAVI collectible card map directory](https://www.wikigtavi.com/map/collectible-cards) offers numbered location listings for named cards, including possible alternate pickups. Individual NFC directory references open the corresponding list entry when supported by the browser; use its numbered row to locate the map marker. Verify the card name and grade before marking progress.

The item-level NFC catalogs contain **10,150 distinct item-to-URL associations across 2,877 linked IDs**, excluding repeated copies of the same URL for an item. Shared venue maps and guide references can legitimately apply to multiple items; this is not a count of unique pickup locations. Category fallback links are separate.

- **Cards and vehicles:** All 480 named cards across 18 sets and 282 Standout Vehicle entries have item-level references; 17 additional named variants have guide references. Sources include [GTA6Wiki collectible cards](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/collectible-card/), [FindLeonida trading cards](https://findleonida.com/en/collectibles/trading-cards/), [GTADB card guides](https://gtadb.net/articles/gta-6-collectible-cards-locations-guide/) and [GTA Town Standout Cars](https://gtatown.com/map/standout-cars). FindLeonida positions are estimates. Nine1Nine's Jesina Gold is also spelled Jesenia in GTA6Wiki; this is the same tracked identity pending in-game verification.
- **Stunts and WAiNK:** All 397 stunts and all 89 WAiNK landmarks, curiosities and sculptures have item-level references. Named alternate maps are available for 202 [bridge crossings](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/under-the-bridge/), 129 of 130 [stunt jumps](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/stunt-jump/), 40 [knife flights](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/knife-flight/), 25 [BASE jumps](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/base-jump/) and all 89 WAiNK [landmarks](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/waink-landmark/), [curiosities](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/waink-curiosity/) and [sculptures](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/waink-sculpture/). The Southpoint Airfield / LTF Airfield alternate-map match remains unresolved. Each bridge also has a numbered [WikiGTAVI map-directory reference](https://www.wikigtavi.com/map/under-the-bridge); select its named row to open the map card. County grouping can differ between guides, so use the named crossing rather than the directory region.
- **Activities and robberies:** Item-level references cover all 42 drone trials, 35 smash and grabs, 39 gang operations, 40 unique races, 13 race challenges, 7 book swaps, 7 pool opponents, 18 meditation completions and 27 publications. [GTA6Wiki map categories](https://gta6wiki.eu/map/) include alternate course and venue maps; some references point to a shared site or named guide rather than an exact pickup pin.

### County coverage

Item notes identify the reported county where an existing location names an unambiguous area, using the [in-game region and sub-region directory](https://thegameswiki.com/gta6/wiki/map-and-regions) and [Leonida geography guide](https://gta6versity.com/en/guides/gta-6-map-locations). County labels support geographic searches, including the card challenge across the five counties. They describe the reported area, not independently surveyed pickup coordinates; conflicting, ambiguous and boundary locations are left unassigned. Provisional leads retain their original status.

### Area sweep references

Individual checklist and vehicle notes include cross-catalog references to other named entries in the same reported district or landmark. These are planning aids based on existing catalog locations, not measured distances, guaranteed nearby spawns, new map pins or shared collection credit. A shared source marker can represent a venue, not the same objective. Follow each entry’s own access and completion conditions. Card notes include [progress-list positions](https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-all-collectible-card-sets-locations/) where the identity can be matched, and explicitly flag uncertain grades or conflicting reports. Selected cards list sibling grades with their catalog IDs; each grade is a separate collection entry, not another pickup of the same card. Existing IDs and original variant labels are preserved. [Additional reported slot evidence](https://gta.exputer.com/gta-6/collectibles/collectible-card-locations/) is identified in individual notes.

- Added numbered alternate map-directory references for all 202 bridge crossings, including the disputed Balsero Overpass North; expanded Randy vehicle scan and alternate acquisition notes, and clarified submarine marker offsets. Preserved existing progress IDs and map links.
- Added numbered illustrated-route references for all 130 stunt jumps, including 130 individual NFC guide links, plus three AHOL location references (two provisional); preserved progress IDs and existing county groupings. Moved internal reconciliation notes to extra.md and consolidated README source references.
- Refined offshore discovery landmarks, meteorite wreck comparisons and named vehicle acquisition routes; retained existing progress IDs.
- Clarified six disputed bank classifications, added numbered branch and named style/tattoo maps, expanded coastal flamingo and unassigned style routes, and corrected a watch name without reallocating progress IDs.
- Cross-referenced decoded save keys for Stick Ups, flamingo groups, style categories, gang operations, banks, pawn/jewelry and loan venues; refined illustrated flamingo, watch, card and style routes; prioritized Beverly Gold map and refined style landmarks and named vehicle map pins without changing progress IDs.
- Reconciled Beverly Gold roster identity, corrected individual hoop/flamingo landmarks, and clarified collection targets and remaining source conflicts.
- Added reported Patriot Cat and Rainbow Poodle encounter areas, new magazine-style routes, court-level hoop comparisons, and clarified unresolved flamingo, meteorite, card and Stick Ups evidence.
- Reconciled watch models and alternate pickups, card links, flamingo aliases, conflicting meteorite/style locations and shared vehicle map anchors; reconciled the 281-name Standout roster and three missing named vehicle leads; added three offline collection-identity guides.
- Reconciled Stick Ups directory membership, basketball route groups, alternate watch locations and additional flamingo/meteorite map leads; added four offline route guides; added 17 independently named Standout variants with collision-checked IDs 5222–5238.
- Reconciled 27 publication titles, seven Book Swaps, six bottled notes and 80 challenge objectives with 19 milestones; expanded alternate copies, individual walkthroughs, chapter restrictions and style leads.
- Reconciled all eight Strangers & Freaks trophy strands and Randy’s 22 reported roster entries; clarified timed Yasmani jobs, mission outcomes, unlocks and separate rewards with individual walkthroughs.
- Expanded vehicle and weapon research with 1,570 reported numerical ratings and statistics, additional rare-animal sale values, variant identities, set memberships, acquisition routes, tracker requirements, pricing and conflicting source reports.
- Expanded collectible and encounter research across cards, flamingos, meteorites, wildlife, underwater discoveries, watches, styles and location leads; added the two Wandering tattoos, the reported twentieth Kitty Litter lab, Del Rio Boulevard Garage, Rocco ending and additional optional Easter eggs.
- Expanded item-level NFC maps and Dispatch coverage (all 22 Randy requests), linked AHOL starter artwork and ending guides, corrected watch and tourist marker associations, and added Secret Mission map shortcuts. Preserved existing progress IDs and save compatibility; distinguished provisional locations and aliases from confirmed collection identities.
- Expanded the Quick Guide to 57 topics with free vehicle registration, the free Thrax exploit, stash-bag overfill, stuck trunk counter and Max Focus training; updated cheat evidence, platform-specific inputs and unlock requirements, safe and door codes (71 entries), hunting delivery requirements, race terms and optional mission rewards.
- Expanded Randy’s finale and Tempesta recovery, Kenton dive progression, safe codes (71), vehicle acquisition and watch research, and 17 individual Standout GPS maps.

Added 79 matched alternate card maps, corrected Missing Tourists chapter access and paired finale reward, and updated exploit confidence notes.

- Added weapon-specific GPS references and alternate interior routes, refined flamingo and meteorite landmarks, and expanded Dog Island rewards, Frampton bunker and Easter egg encounter instructions.
- Expanded vehicle-specific map references, condition and tracker conflict notes, time-dependent spawns and wildlife encounter routes, including zoo access and captive bird heatmaps.

Reconciled all 18 Delights Dancers pickup descriptions and added individual guide references, selected Jack of Hearts access clues and Easter egg landmarks.

- Reconciled pickup coverage for the final five sports-card sets (126 slots; 348/480 across 14 sets), added illustrated pickup references and alternate access details; retained variant and roster conflicts without changing progress IDs.

## Peewees and No Flusher collection audit — November 27, 2026

All four existing Peewees IDs (1368–1371) matched the routes by county and highway. Added facing and approach instructions and the final prize workflow. Games.gg and GTA Walkthrough agree on west-facing scans in Vice-Dale and Mariana, north-facing scans in Leonard and Lummox. Push Square places the Mariana sign west of Richardson Hunting Supplies; Cutscene Wire says east. Both place it in the US-82 median, so no location ID or existing map was changed. Insider Gaming provides additional road-sign landmarks. The collection was already numerically complete; this update completes the previously missing walkthrough fields rather than discovering four new billboards.

All 15 No Flusher IDs (1344–1358) match the Findora/IGN landmark directory. The GTA6.house quest guide reports ten of the 15 scans advance the quest, and describes ten Ocean Beach stops. The existing Ocean Beach route is preserved while the notes distinguish the collection count and quest threshold. No proof of a mandatory fixed ten-tag subset was found. No additional GPS links were added.

Bret's Target Decks: Leonida Tracks still lists decks 4–15 without a complete species roster; the archive already contains partial deck 4 evidence. Luxury watches: the 25-marker WikiGTAVI directory has alternate copies and unnamed pickups, while the 34-location video index provides no item-by-item textual roster. Full watch and deck identity completion remains blocked; no new IDs allocated. The source links are retained in more_sources.md.

Validation scope: static source archive, TSV identity/field checks and ZIP integrity. No firmware compilation, physical Flipper test or gameplay verification.

- `5234` Bravado Interdimensional Youga: Reported two-seat 1974 Youga with psychedelic artwork. ([source](https://game-checklists.com/gta6/standout-vehicles-checklist/))
- `5235` Buckingham Lacewing Maverick: Reported four-seat Maverick. ([source](https://game-checklists.com/gta6/standout-vehicles-checklist/))
- `5238` Nagasaki Chrome Street Blazer: Reported chrome finish; look for a roadside cargo container. ([source](https://game-checklists.com/gta6/standout-vehicles-checklist/))
- `1392` Loophole Architecture: Use the apartment lobby elevator to reach the roof; aim the phone camera downward at the rainbow roof across the street. ([source](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-1010-murals/))
- `1393` Extraction Service: Take the lobby elevator to the roof and use the marked corner; use the camera, not a WAiNK scan. ([source](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-1010-murals/))
- `1394` You Signed the Terms & Conditions: Wait until the matching painted train is stopped at the station before photographing. ([source](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-1010-murals/))
- `1395` Compliance Theater: Take the elevator to the roof, then climb the radio tower to the sign. ([source](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-1010-murals/))
- `1396` Privatized Pains Socialized Gains: Use the mark beside the small parking lot; aim at the southeast corner of the public garage. ([source](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-1010-murals/))
- `2315` Grotti 1010 Cheetah: The reward garage is east of the airport beside Slator Towing. All five camera photos, not WAiNK scans, must register; free garage access is also reported. ([source](https://www.gtavl.com/news/gta-6-1010-murals/))
- `555` Leroy Rook (Gold): Night approach reported: back entrance, then low closet safe in the bedroom by the front door. Reported safe cash $178, separate from the card. Pawn Stash displayed $8,500 total collectible value, not an isolated card sale; treat $8,500 as a provisional upper bound. ([source](https://www.gta6heists.com/money/collectible-cards))
- `570` Leroy Rook (Silver): A filmed Hamlet Pawn sale corroborates the $6,000 Silver variant price. ([source](https://www.gta6heists.com/money/collectible-cards))
- `793` Victor Maravilla: An inventory screenshot corroborates the $20 Standard card value. ([source](https://www.gta6heists.com/money/collectible-cards))
- `1006` Thelma: A pawn-shop map screenshot reports $20 after this pickup; the illustrated tower approach uses stairs and two ladders. ([source](https://www.gta6heists.com/money/collectible-cards))

## Base vehicle scan reconciliation

- New reference: 123 named base models, 615 individual numeric scan ratings. Source: GTA6Gang, 27 Nov 2026, reproducing reported Dexerto data. This is a single underlying dataset, not independent in-game testing. The reference does not assert that all 277 base models have been identified. No base-model progress IDs were allocated.
- GTA Addict reports 240 named models but only 94 corroborated by multiple lists. The Company Cars mission report lists Comet S2 speed 7.8 / asphalt 7.2 versus 7.7 / 7.6 in the general table, and 1988 Comet speed 6.2 / asphalt 6.1 / off-road 4.6 / strength 3.0 versus 6.1 / 6.5 / 4.0 / 3.7. Do not merge the different measurement contexts. Kamacho mission strength 6.2 versus general 3.0 likewise remains unresolved.
- Alcast Nov 27 location roster overlaps most existing Standout directions; only three distinct clues were incorporated. Broad area names, vehicle type, and repeat pickup directions were not counted as new facts.
- Wildlife source review: Hundo Maps and GTA6Walk still do not give specific locations for many domestic breeds; novelty animal directory records also remain location-incomplete. No invented encounter points or progress IDs added.
- Counts for this update: 615 numeric fields in a new reference, three supplemental vehicle pickup fields; source notes, headings, and guide navigation excluded. No additional GPS links.

## Expanded vehicle directory reconciliation

- 660 distinct additions to the Quick Guide reference, including 155 reported directory identities. These are not all newly discovered game entities: some were already mentioned in other app catalogs, and directory identities are not validated as separate scan slots. The previous 123 five-rating model entries remain unchanged.
- OpenLeonida lists 279 vehicles; the completion guide reports 277 base models. Boat and aircraft counts differ. The 200-scan target is retained. No new progress IDs, guessed statistics or GPS links were allocated.
- GTA Town ratings take precedence within the supplemental directory when present; Maibatsu Penumbra speed differs (5.3 vs OpenLeonida 5.2). Do not conflate these with GTA6Legit individual scan scores.
- GTAFinder prices are reported estimates; individual GTA6Legit PS5 scans can show different amounts and condition. Where both sources supply a registration fee or scan sale figure, the second observation was not counted again. GTAFinder lists Caracara 4x4 registration at $5,550, while GTA6Legit reports $18,500; verify eligibility and the actual fee rather than treating the directory as authoritative.
- Wildlife: most newly reviewed landmarks are already in the catalog; unresolved domestic breeds and other specific encounter locations remain open. Meteorite directories report inconsistent marker totals and individual locations could not be verified from the JavaScript map; no extra progress IDs were allocated. Bret's last three contracts and collectible identity conflicts remain unresolved.
- Counting excludes navigation headings, source links, repeated speed ratings, duplicate registration and sale observations, and unspecified fields. Firmware build and hardware testing were not performed.

## Style collection and shopping reconciliation

- Allocated unused IDs 5239–5254 for 12 previously guide-only Jason/Lucia styles and four named tattoo sites. Previous IDs and link assets remain unchanged. The 22 tattoo rows include paired designs and Stamped Tattoo, so they are not a 22-credit roster. The newer reported Gnome route is beside SR-37. Walrus/Hipster and Triangle/Shards are treated as aliases of the same prior guide locations.
- The November 27 watch roster is reported as 33 of 34; IGN itself could not be retrieved directly. Existing watch IDs and old lead records remain; the route pages distinguish model finishes and physical sites without allocating ambiguous additional watch checkmarks. The reported Yellow Gold/Green Submerge is unlocated. Halifax/Palmer Fishing Bobby Ambrose overlap remains unresolved.
- Clothing entries describe stock, not verified current prices. Distinct color/design options, retailer associations, prices/ranges and character availability are counted as facts; blank fields are not counted. Combined colors are one design, price ranges are one field, and guide headings and item identities are excluded. Some stock sources may derive from the same player captures. Districts are not new GPS links.
- Wildlife, Bret, meteorite and card identity conflicts remain open. No firmware compilation or gameplay testing performed.

- Ledger total: 591 entries, of which 16 are checklist promotions (not counted as new research fields). The other 575 are recorded source-backed field additions: 526 clothing/shop fields and 49 pickup/variant/access fields. No claim that 575 independent game entities were discovered.

## Watch and offshore reconciliation

- 38 watch checklist records, including 15 guide-only candidate promotions and five existing leads moved under their original IDs. The list exceeds 34 because legacy aliases and alternate sources are retained; do not infer full completion or additional game slots. No new GPS links. IDs 5255–5276 allocated to guide promotions and provisional offshore leads.
- WikiGTAVI reports 117 meteorite map markers; GTABase reports 121. Seven additional search leads are provisional and do not change the 83 established fragment records.
- The purported complete late deck sequence conflicts with established wildlife names and Burmese python captivity guidance; retained only as explicitly unverified reference, not as contract requirements.
- Ledger: 575 research fields, 20 checklist promotions and 7 reconciliation entries. No firmware compilation or hardware test performed.

- Added 448 distinct technical vehicle fields for 112 directory identities. The source reports handling-file values, mass without an explicit game-file unit (interpreted as kg), an unspecified acceleration test in seconds and relative braking indices. No independent file extraction or game testing was performed; these must not replace existing WAiNK ratings. Names are retained as directory labels; no new scan slots or checkmarks are assigned.

## Catalog editorial review
- Baseline: 2.1, 79 Quick Guide topics. Reviewed all 150 TSV files for structure and targeted player-facing wording. Removed repeated unrelated nearby activities, internal save-key notes, directory-crosswalk commentary, community map marker counts and non-gameplay card metadata. Existing county information was retained unless explicitly duplicated in the location. Map uncertainty and alternate pickup identities remain labeled.
- Reworded existing guide topics in place; no new guide topics or previously discarded bulk references restored. Existing titles were clarified where they described research rather than a gameplay action. The separate Glitches and warehouse guide files are unchanged.
- Street Art Squalo entries 210 and 3619 are reported aliases for one pickup. Both existing progress slots remain to avoid silently changing saved progress. Not established leads and alternate locations remain in their established catalogs; an editorial review cannot determine their real in-game validity.
- Full original and revised text is retained in the separately supplied editorial change ledger, including removed administrative research details. Source URLs and technical lookup/link TSVs are preserved. This is an editorial and structural review, not independent gameplay verification.

## Editorial conventions

Use `Not established` for uncertain pickup locations or identity matches. Keep location clues, access requirements, meaningful gameplay warnings, and alternate coordinates. Do not repeat generic counter or identity-verification instructions. Public release notes describe shipping features, not discarded intermediate content.
